# Russell 2000 (^RUT): research brief for 2026-08-24 to 2026-09-15

## 1. Resolution source
- 2026-08-24: ^RUT closed at **2,995.08**, down 22.79 points (about -0.76%). The Yahoo close collected by code (2995.0801) matches news reports of the session. [La Nacion/AP](https://www.lanacion.com.ar/usa/how-major-us-stock-indexes-fared-monday-8242026-nid24082026/)
- I did not fetch the Yahoo Finance page directly. The baseline close above came from the code-collected Yahoo data.
- The resolution value is the 2026-09-15 close, which is 15 trading sessions ahead (Labor Day, 2026-09-07, is a market holiday).

## 2. Current status
- Nothing settles the question yet. It depends on the 2026-09-15 close.
- 2026-08-14: the index set a record close of 3,068.42, after the previous record of 3,052.85 on 2026-08-13. The 2026-08-24 close is about 2.4% below that record. [Wikipedia](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Russell_2000_Index)

## 3. Recent news (newest first)
- 2026-08-24: Stocks ended mixed. The Dow rose 0.3% to 53,417, the S&P 500 fell 0.3% to 7,652.86, the Nasdaq fell 0.8%, and the Russell 2000 fell 0.8%. Money rotated out of tech into defensive sectors ahead of Nvidia earnings on Wednesday. The Russell 2000 was up about 20.7% year to date. [La Nacion/AP](https://www.lanacion.com.ar/usa/how-major-us-stock-indexes-fared-monday-8242026-nid24082026/), [StockMarketWatch digest](https://stockmarketwatch.com/digest/2026-08-24)
- 2026-08-24: Yahoo Finance ran a Russell 2000 stock-pick piece that day, but it has no macro content. [Yahoo](https://finance.yahoo.com/markets/stocks/articles/1-russell-2000-stock-target-151336393.html)
- 2026-08-19: CME FedWatch priced about a 33% chance of a rate **hike** at the September 15-16 FOMC meeting, and about 67% for a hold. Cut expectations had fallen to roughly zero. The effective fed funds rate was about 3.63%. [CryptoBriefing](https://cryptobriefing.com/us-august-job-gains-surpass-forecasts-impacting-fed-rate-hike-expectations/)
- 2026-08-18: The Nasdaq fell 1.33%. Mid-August was choppy after the small-cap record. [NBC Palm Springs](https://www.nbcpalmsprings.com/2026/08/18/wall-street-ends-lower-as-nasdaq-drops-133-in-august-18-trading)
- 2026-08-14: The Russell 2000 hit an all-time high and was outpacing the S&P 500 with a year-to-date gain of more than 22%. [24/7 Wall St.](https://247wallst.com/investing/2026/08/14/the-russell-2000-hits-all-time-highs-4-ultra-high-yield-dividend-stocks-to-buy-hand-over-fist/)
- The macro backdrop: the Fed, chaired by Kevin Warsh, is leaning hawkish because inflation is above target. Small caps are the most sensitive to rate-hike risk.

## 4. Base rates
The code baseline uses 15-session returns over the last 3 years, with the last year weighted double. Converted to percent change from 2,995.08:

| Percentile | Price | % change |
|---|---|---|
| p5 | 2,798.1 | -6.6% |
| p10 | 2,862.5 | -4.4% |
| p25 | 2,964.1 | -1.0% |
| p50 | 3,044.5 | +1.7% |
| p75 | 3,116.8 | +4.1% |
| p90 | 3,205.4 | +7.0% |
| p95 | 3,268.7 | +9.1% |

- The interquartile range is about 5 points wide, and the 5-95 range is about 16 points.
- The median has an upward drift of about 1.7%, which reflects the strong rally over the sample period.
- September is historically one of the weakest months for US equities. This is a common seasonal claim that I did not verify against data here.

## 5. Other forecasts
- I found no Polymarket, Kalshi or Manifold market on the Russell 2000 level for 2026-09-15.
- Related: a Manifold market on a Fed hike in 2026 was around 46% in late August. That reading is dated 2026-08-26, one day after the cutoff, so I'm treating it as context only. [tech-insider](https://tech-insider.org/manifold-fed-interest-rate-hike-2026-odds/)
- I found no published expert targets for the Russell 2000 over this specific window.

## 6. Upcoming events before resolution
- **2026-08-26 (Wed):** Nvidia earnings. This is a major sentiment event for the whole market. [La Nacion/AP](https://www.lanacion.com.ar/usa/how-major-us-stock-indexes-fared-monday-8242026-nid24082026/)
- **About 2026-08-27 to 08-29:** Jackson Hole symposium, with Chair Warsh giving his first keynote (expected 2026-08-28). This is the biggest rate-path catalyst. A hawkish tone would tend to hurt small caps the most.
- **Late August:** July PCE inflation data.
- **2026-09-04 (Fri):** August jobs report.
- **2026-09-07:** Labor Day, markets closed.
- **About 2026-09-10 to 09-11:** August PPI and CPI. These are probably the last key inputs before the FOMC meeting.
- **2026-09-15:** The first day of the FOMC meeting is the resolution date. The decision comes on 2026-09-16, after resolution, so only positioning into the meeting matters. Pricing for a hike or a hold will shape the 2026-09-15 close.
